ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; remind the driver that the "I'm Here" tap and an in-radius continuous 3-minute wait are mandatory before a no-show cancellation, and that unrecorded presence cannot support the fee.
ruling.reasoning: Route NS-0: cancelled_by = driver and the driver asserts rider no-show, so the case is decided under NS-1/NS-2. Non-taxi (RydeX), so no metered issues arise; the only disputed item is the $6.61 cancellation fee. NS-1 requires (i) the driver pressed "I'm Here" (or platform auto-confirmed arrival) AND (ii) at that moment GPS showed him at the pickup (≤200 m) AND (iii) continuous in-radius waiting >3 min after the tap. The record shows driver_pressed_here_at = null, arrival_confirmed_by = null, wait_started_at = null, fee_applied_at = null; the driver himself admits "I forgot to press the I'm Here button." Element (i) therefore fails, which alone is decisive under NS-2. For completeness: his vehicle (GPS at 1.43603, 103.78614 from 22:43:00 to 22:46:50) is ~230–240 m from the stated pickup point (1.436, 103.7865), i.e. outside the 200 m arrival radius used for element (ii), and the closest approach during his loop (1.43436,103.78600 at 22:41:30) is ~60 m from a different point of the polyline — not the named pickup. Also, the GPS trace is thinned (5 s grid → every 6th sample, 30 s spacing), so it cannot corroborate any "I'm Here" event; it neither fills nor creates the missing claim. Timeline check: accepted 22:37:00, driver_arrived_at 22:41:30, cancelled 22:46:50 — 9 min 50 s after acceptance, of which only the final 3 min 50 s was stationary near the pickup, but no legal start-of-wait marker exists. Since NS-1 (i) (and (ii)) are not met, the $6.61 cancellation fee did not validly arise → full refund of $6.61 (voucher form, NS-7). No RD/flag conditions: no route deviation, and route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 rules out RD-6; the driver's failure is a button/timing issue, not usage of the button with false GPS (he never used it at all), so NS-2's fraud add-on is not triggered. Safety screen: chat contains only a plain pickup identification and a wait/cancel notice; nothing threatening, abusive, sexual or dangerous — safety_concern = none.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver claims he waited 4 minutes at the pickup, but he concedes he never pressed "I'm Here" and the record has driver_pressed_here_at = null with no platform auto-confirmation. NS-1(i) therefore fails, and at the times he was stationary (22:43:00–22:46:50, 1.43603/103.78614) GPS places him ~230–240 m from the pickup point — outside the 200 m arrival radius for NS-1(ii). Unrecorded presence does not satisfy the no-show conditions.

The rider's factual account (driver cancelled, $6.61 charged) is accepted; his reason for the refund differs from the clause actually applied (NS-1/NS-2 failure, not his being en route), so the rider's justification is not relied on but the outcome is.
